In summary, our research is concerned with
the parameterization of immersion freezing in a climate model.
the development of a CNT based parameter estimation scheme for GCM simulations to improve the representation of heterogeneous ice formation in mixed phase clouds.

the question of how the freezing curves of insoluble particles can be described with CNT and what the sensitivity of the parameter estimation is to thermodynamic and/or kinetic parameters in the case where the particle properties are described by contact angle schemes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
no single contact angle scheme is able to represent the freezing behavior of all investigated aerosol particles.
the contact angle scheme is not able to mask the uncertainties in thermodynamic and kinetics parameters.
the CNT based parameterizations are not able to describe the measured freezing curves in a satisfactory way, neither in a deterministic nor stochastic way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a contact angle scheme is needed to describe the immersion freezing process, but that the choice of the parameterization scheme is not critical.
the CNT parameterization scheme with a constant contact angle is the most promising parameterization scheme to represent immersion freezing in GCMs.

the CNT parameterization scheme for immersion freezing with contact angle scheme (1) is able to reproduce measured freezing data and the time and size dependence of the immersion freezing process best.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CNT parameterization scheme is not only sensitive to the properties of aerosols but also to unconstrained kinetic parameters.
a parameterization of immersion freezing based on the CNT is not only a function of the contact angle but also a function of the kinetic and thermodynamic properties of the aerosol particles.

CNT based parameterizations are able to describe the time and particle-size dependence of the immersion freezing process and that the contact angle scheme is the most important parameter in CNT based parameterized immersion freezing.
